name: External Entities Storage Client for Mediawiki
description: An External Entities storage plugin for MediaWiki content.
project_description:
This module provides a storage client plugin for Mediawiki content to External Entities module. This module was initially integrated into External Entities as a native plugin before External Entities v3. Since External Entities v3, this module is now a separated plugin.

 Features 
 With this plugin you can use wiki (MediaWiki, Wikipedia) page content from another site into your Drupal site just like if they were local without any synchronization process (updated live).

 Post-Installation 
 You will have to create a new external entity type and use and configure the Wiki storage client.

 Additional Requirements
